representation: Closed edit-topology associations. Quotient out unchanged run lengths, preserve all changed words/direction/order. Normalizer is a supplied structural prior; incompatible associations abstain.
identity_supervision: Explicit reflexivity teaching using only public train statements; not an independent evaluation.
selection: One deterministic policy. Train only original train and declared logical supervision; validation and consumed test remain separate, all abstentions included.
acceptance: Development only. Recount, reflexivity, original reviewer strata and parent retention required; no automatic M1 promotion or M2 start.
limits: 300 seconds per process, original genome/rule caps. Unknown/ambiguous/oversized inputs refuse. No second agent, LLM or energy/RSS claim.
